basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: Contacts Backup makes backup files of your contacts on your device. There is no server sync: you send the backup to yourself by email.
onDevice: Your contacts, read to back them up, find duplicates and clean them
Backup files (.vcf and .csv), created on your device

permissions.name: Contacts
permissions.why: To back up, merge and clean your contacts.

purchases: Premium is sold through the App Store as a subscription. Apple handles payment.
